Hi again! 🌱 Thanks for checking before you sign up.

**If you've already used free shipping, you wouldn't get the refund.** Free Standard shipping is one of the Leafy Plus benefits, so using it counts as using a benefit. That means:

- **No refund**, even if you cancel within the 14 days.
- **Your benefits continue** until the end of your paid year (the $59/year).

I should also tighten up my last message. I said it wasn't clear which actions count as using a benefit, but free shipping is a listed benefit, so I'd treat it as used. The knowledge base doesn't list every other case, so I can't say for certain about those.

If you're still deciding, a safe approach is to hold off on placing orders that use membership perks until you're sure. If you think your situation deserves an exception, I can escalate it to a Support Lead, though I can't promise a particular outcome.

Is there anything else I can help with? 💚
